FieldNotes.Comments: Site in grassy field with small cacti and shrubbery. 150 meters from lake shore, 75 meters from small dirt trail, oil rig half a mile away. Bedrock very close to surface, nims kept above ground. Battery LFP0674 at 13.56V. mag cable NMC38 X-array with no rotation. East line shortened 3 meters due to bedrock and trail, West line unable to be extended due to water table. Run on HH.
